source_of_truth: hand-authored synthetic fixture — NOT part of the walkthrough (demo-learning-*). Built to cover the ESCALATE disposition, which no existing fixture exercises.
purpose: Give the scorer a case where the correct call is to abstain because the decisive evidence is out of reach, so decide_route's non-REPAIR short-circuit is exercised for ESCALATE specifically, authored independently of the walkthrough world.
root_cause_explanation: revenue_by_region shows a sustained drop for one region, but the only table that could confirm whether this is a currency-conversion defect or a genuine regional sales decline (fx_rates_daily) sits in a partner-owned schema that get_schema and run_sql are both denied against by policy. Every tool available returns ACCESS_DENIED for that schema. Without it, a REPAIR or NO_REPAIR call would be a guess dressed up as a diagnosis.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Not applicable — no repair should be proposed for this incident; the decisive evidence is unreachable, not merely unexamined.
repair_must_satisfy.validation_requirement: N/A — an ESCALATE decision carries no ValidationResult to check.

why_not_repair: There is no confirmed defect to fix. Proposing one without access to fx_rates_daily would be guessing at a root cause the investigator cannot actually verify.
why_not_no_repair: The drop is real and unexplained by anything reachable; declaring it fine without checking the one table that could confirm or rule out a currency defect is premature, not diligent.

scoring_notes.root_cause_match: not applicable — an ESCALATE decision is not expected to carry a resolved root_cause_id. correct_root_cause_id is null on purpose; a decision that reports a confident root_cause_id alongside ESCALATE is internally inconsistent and should be flagged in manual review, though scoring.py's routing does not check this on its own.
scoring_notes.repair_match: not applicable — score_repair_validation treats any non-REPAIR disposition as trivially 'correct' on this axis (scoring.py:35-36)

test_fixtures.note: Two hypothetical InvestigationDecisions to run the scorer against, not real A output.

case_correct_escalate.label: should be judged CORRECT — deterministic, no judge call

decision.root_cause_summary: Regional revenue drop could be a currency-conversion defect or a genuine decline; fx_rates_daily is required to distinguish the two and every tool call against it returned ACCESS_DENIED.

case_guessed_instead_of_escalating.label: should be judged INCORRECT — guessed NO_REPAIR instead of abstaining on missing evidence

decision.root_cause_summary: Assumed the drop is a genuine regional sales decline without being able to check fx_rates_daily.

freeze_note: Synthetic fixture, not a scored incident — stays unfrozen and is not counted in any reported result. Kept separate from the walkthrough world under fixtures/ per Person C's own separation rule.
